title: Atomic Multiplier
keywords: Duplicates eligible stackable input using circuit boards and a large FE batch

blocks.text: Duplicates eligible stackable input using circuit boards and a large FE batch. The blacklist excludes protected progression items.

rows: Put one eligible stackable item and seven circuit boards in the first eight input slots.
Accumulate the current full batch cost; the default is 1.5 billion FE.
Leave room for four copies and let the batch complete.

blocks.text: Unstackable or blacklisted items are refused. Increasing cable voltage does not bypass the item blacklist or the FE requirement.

Read the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.
